name: Traditional Millet Health Mix (Sathu Maavu)
shortDescription: A wholesome traditional blend of sprouted millets, pulses, and nuts for everyday family nutrition.
description: Rooted in rural heritage, our Traditional Health Mix is crafted from a multigrain recipe passed down through generations. Carefully roasted and ground, this mix provides natural energy and essential nutrients, making it a perfect morning drink for all age groups.
benefits: Rich in dietary fiber and protein
No added refined sugars or preservatives
howToUse: Mix 2 tablespoons of health mix in 1 cup of water or milk without lumps.
Cook on medium flame for 3-5 minutes, stirring continuously.
Add jaggery or natural sweetener to taste.
manufacturingMethod: Dry roasted in traditional cast iron and finely ground
storageInstructions: Store in an airtight container away from moisture.
